submitted.rationale: I focused on compositions near BiVO4 (Bi:V close to 1:1), since that is the phase known to work as a visible-light photoanode. The V-rich sample 10 (Bi 0.436) gave the highest photocurrent, 2.33e-5 A. That was about 4x the near-1:1 sample 14 and about 75x the Bi-rich sample 1. Photocurrent rose steadily toward the V-rich side.

rejected.reason: Measured 3.1e-7 A. Bi-rich samples drop off sharply
Its composition (Bi 0.429) is close to index 10 and it may be comparable, but the merit budget ran out before it could be measured
Too Bi-rich to be BiVO4; the trend from index 1 suggests low photocurrent
